Good morning, and welcome aboard. This ferry is going to leave in about ten minutes, and the crossing takes fifty five minutes. If the sea is calm we will arrive a little earlier. The upper deck is open, and I recommend it: the view of the coastline as we leave the harbor is the best part of the trip. There is a small cafe downstairs, but it only takes cash today. The last ferry back tonight leaves at nine, so please do not miss it. Enjoy the crossing.

So you have three days here. Here is what I would recommend. On the first day, do not plan anything at all. Just explore the old town on foot and let it surprise you. On the second day, take the early ferry to the island, because after eleven the boats are full of people. And on the third day, drive the scenic road north. There is a lookout point about twenty minutes out of town, on the left, with no sign and no bus. Most visitors never find it, and it is the view you will remember.

First they are going to fly to Split at the end of August. Then they are going to spend four nights on the coast. On the second morning they are going to take the ferry to one of the islands. On the fourth day they are going to drive the scenic road along the coastline. Finally they are going to arrive in Ljubljana with nothing booked at all.
